data.narrative:
Aepnus Technology is a Seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Lukas Hackl and Bilen Akuzum that has raised $10.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine frontier-energy peers: one public company (Limonera, ticker LNZA) and eight private firms including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy frontier-tech vertical to support a robust peer-median methodology; only one valuation approach proved applicable.

The Stage-Progression method is appropriate here, applying a 2.5x multiplier to the $10.6M total raised as a proxy for current valuation. This yields an implied value of $26M. This multiplier reflects typical step-up dynamics from Seed to the next institutional funding round and is the sole triangulation method with sufficient empirical support given peer-set constraints.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M (low) to $30M (high), with a median point of $26M. This range carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method. Key uncertainties include the applicability of standard stage-progression multiples in the early-stage frontier climate sector, where funding velocity and investor risk appetite may diverge from broader venture norms. A refined valuation would benefit from expanded climate-tech Seed comparables or forward-looking revenue/impact metrics as the company de-risks its technology.
